Request on WhatsApp Request by email

No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

On this walk you examine evidence and scholarly debates around exchange and port functions.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Site orientation and chronology
  • Public accessible excavated remains
  • Trade artefact evidence from available displays
  • Port interpretation and alternative hypotheses

How the time is spent

  1. Site orientation and chronology 30 min

  2. Public accessible excavated remains 60 min

  3. Trade artefact evidence from available displays 65 min

  4. Port interpretation and alternative hypotheses 25 min

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Place the excavated remains at Lothal within the chronology of the site.
  • Assess trade artefacts in the available displays as evidence of exchange.
  • Compare the port interpretation of Lothal with the alternative hypotheses in scholarly debate.

You take away

An interpretation sheet with questions to ask on site and suggested reading.
